ClassMembers.name: BankTcpServices
ClassMembers.summary: Provides TCP-based services for communicating with the bank server from the UI layer. Supports checking server availability and retrieving runtime information.

ClassMembers.name: DatabaseService
ClassMembers.summary: Service class responsible for read-only access to the UI database layer. Provides methods to retrieve active accounts, closed accounts, and recent client command activity using SQL Server views. Maintains an open SQL connection for repeated queries.

ClassMembers.name: AccountInfo
ClassMembers.summary: Data model representing a bank account for UI presentation. Contains basic account information including account number, current balance, creation date, and optional closure date.

ClassMembers.name: ClientInfo
ClassMembers.summary: Data model representing a single client activity record for the UI. Stores the client IP address, the last executed command with arguments, the execution timestamp, and the resulting status of the command.

ClassMembers.name: MainViewModel
ClassMembers.summary: Main ViewModel for the UI application implementing the MVVM pattern. Manages server connectivity state, periodic data refresh, and exposes collections of active accounts, closed accounts, and recent client activity for data binding. Coordinates communication with the bank server via TCP services and reads persistent data through the database service.
